The Nigerian Institute of Mechanical Engineers (NIMechE) has called for the enhancement of the relationship between engineering and national security as well as boost local production of facilities in thd country
Engr. Dr. Babagana Modu Tela, the NIMechE National Chairman, stated this in his welcome address at the 39th International Conference, Exhibition and Annual General Meeting in Abuja recently
He said the theme of this year’s conference “Mechanical Engineers as Catalysts of Innovation for Enhanced Security and Sustainable National Development” is timely and strategic because engineering is fundamentally about solving problems.
While calling on mechanical engineers to build a profession where young Nigerians can confidently say “I can design, manufacture, and improve it”, he said the 2026 conference is a platform for knowledge exchange, professional networking, technology transfer and institutional collaboration.
Engr. Dr. Babagana Modu Tela said mechanical engineers have the responsibility of contributing professionally and ethically to the development of technologies that strengthen national resilience while supporting peaceful and sustainable development.
He said “we must also encourage collaboration among government, academia, industry and professional institutions so that engineering knowledge can be effectively converted into solutions that address real national needs”.
NSE President, Engr. Ali Alimasuya Rabiu, in his message, said engineering has a vital role to play in contributing to the development, adaptation and mainteningof engineering machinery towards national security.
